svg.title: ControlNet 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它依賴什麼 condition與會交出什麼 synthetic candidate；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

svg.text: 生成與修復方法的差異在條件如何約束去噪，以及輸出是合成／估計候選，還是能被原始證據

g.data-semantic-relation: keep raw evidence and generation condition separate
g.data-must-show: ControlNet：source + versioned spatial condition 引導 base diffusion | candidate output: synthetic/edited image + provenance bundle | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: ControlNet output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: ControlNet：source + versioned spatial condition 引導 base diffusion
